recipe.title: Supernatural Brownies
recipe.note: 350°F · Butter a 9 × 13-inch pan; line with buttered parchment. Makes 15 large or 24 small brownies.
recipe.ingredients:
2 sticks (16 tbsp) butter
8 oz bittersweet chocolate
1 cup dark brown sugar
1 cup granulated sugar
4 eggs
1/2 tsp salt
2 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup all-purpose flour (120g)
1/2 cup chopped OR 3/4 cup whole walnuts (optional)

actions.text: Melt over barely simmering water or microwave on low; cool slightly
Whisk eggs, then salt and vanilla
Stir in chopped walnuts, if using. Pour into pan; top with whole walnuts instead, if using
Bake 35–40 min, until shiny and cracking on top
Cool in pan on rack. Best next day: cool, then wrap tightly
